clips.asr_text: Today's topic is The Open Window.
開いた窓
療養のため田舎を訪れたフラムトンは、初対面の少女と話すことになります。短い訪問の中で、会話が進むにつれて場の雰囲気がどう変わるのか、登場人物の様子に注目して聞いてみてください。
ヴェラが開いた窓についてどんな話をするのかに注目してください。
ベラは、叔母が夫たちの帰りを今も待っていると話しました。叔母が戻った後、窓の外を見たフラムトンはどうするのでしょうか。
叔母が夫と弟たちの帰りを待っていると聞き、フラムトンは怯えました。振り返った彼の目には何が映るのでしょうか。
Letter of Introduction
紹介状
Go cold.
ゾッとする
Struggle for breath.
息をするのに苦しむ。
Frampton sat on his chair's edge, turning his letter of introduction. His doctor suggested country air, but visiting strangers brought little peace.
My aunt will join us soon.
said fifteen-year-old Vera.
How well do you know her?
I know very little.
Frampton answered. Vera looked at the wide open window leading onto the lawn.
Something terrible happened to her exactly three years ago today.
The letter lay still in Frampton's hands.

Her husband and two younger brothers left through that window. They went shooting, taking their small brown spaniel with them. They tried crossing wet ground, but it broke under them. All of them disappeared, and nobody ever found their bodies.
How awful!
said Frampton quietly.
She still believes they'll return, so she waits until dark. That's why she leaves the window open.
Veera said more quietly.
Her eyes moved across the lawn, but nobody was there.
On evenings like this, I sometimes think they might appear.
her aunt came in quickly, before Frampton could answer her.
Has Vera been looking after you? I hope the open window doesn't bother you. My husband and brothers are coming back from shooting soon. Their boots will be muddy, as usual.

Frampton went cold because she really did expect them back. He talked about his health problems and avoided the window, but his hostess hardly listened, often looking past him towards the lawn. Then a happy smile suddenly appeared on her face.
Look, they're finally home!
Vera's eyes opened wide as she looked outside in fear. Frampton looked behind him.
Three men crossed the lawn with guns as daylight faded. One carried a white coat, and a brown spaniel followed. A young man's voice reached them across the silent garden.

Crampton struggled for breath as the dead approached the house. He took his hat and stick and hurried outside. Moments later, he was racing down the drive. The men came through the window, hungry and covered in mud.
Who just left?
Her husband asked.
Such a strange man.
She replied.
He described his nervous problems, then ran off without warning.
The dog frightened him.
Vera said, sounding perfectly calm.
He told me dogs terrified him. A group chased him into an empty grave in India. He stayed there all night while they growled above him.
Vera needed only seconds to invent a story people believed.
